name: Evidence-Backed Talent Proof Portal
problem: Talent discovery relies heavily on resumes and claims that poorly connect demonstrated capability to opportunities.
use_when: help me hire based on skills
inputs: Authorized candidate/profile evidence, competency model, target role/opportunity and organization privacy requirements.
outputs: Evidence-backed profiles, competency proof, opportunity routing and outcomes tracking.
pricing: Current organization hypothesis $500-$3,000/month; not auto-quotable yet.
confirmation: No employment decision is automated by discovery. Participant consent/authority and payment are required where applicable.
invocation_status: Discoverable capability; privacy/onboarding acceptance work pending.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
